 ET Online New Zealand will take on India in the third ODI on November 10 at Seddon Park in Hamilton. The hosts will be eager to stage a comeback after suffering two consecutive defeats, while Shubman Gill's side will look to secure a series victory with another win. Batting remains a major concern for New Zealand, with the team struggling to build momentum throughout the series. The opening batters, especially, have faced difficulties handling the seam and swing generated by India's bowling attack. However, the toss has been delayed due to heavy rains.
 New Zealand vs India 3rd ODI Match Details
The third ODI between India and New Zealand will be played on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at Seddon Park in Hamilton. Here are the key match details:
